summary: Iteration 9 (frontend-only) validated the 3 new Leads-page features and role changes end-to-end. OPS + ADMIN scenarios executed against the preview URL. Date column shows formatted dates (e.g. '18 Aug 2026'). Date range filter presets ALL/TODAY/7D/30D and custom from/to inputs all update the leads-count-label correctly (ALL=248, TODAY=4, 7D=10, 30D=164, custom 2026-08-18=4). Ops can assign a growth partner via the per-row dropdown; assignment persists after reload and assign-history line renders 'by Operations · 18 Aug' on both desktop row and mobile card. Ops sees bulk-partner-select + bulk-assign-btn but NOT bulk-delete-btn. Admin sees bulk-delete-btn. Mobile viewport (390px) hides the desktop table (computed display:none) and renders leads-card-list with 25 lead-card-* items exposing lead-date-m, call-link-m, assign-select-m and assign-history-m testids. partner-filter is visible to ops.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.jsx is 405 lines — still manageable but the mobile-card block duplicates a lot of markup (call link, partner select, assign history). Consider extracting a LeadCard/LeadRow component to remove duplication (DRY).
assign() ignores partner_id when '' is chosen for mobile because select onChange passes event; behaviour already sends partner_id:null via `partnerId || null` — OK.
Custom date input onChange sets datePreset='CUSTOM' but the preset ALL/TODAY/7D/30D buttons never re-highlight when user types partial dates — cosmetic only.
fmtShort assumes browser locale; consider fixed 'en-GB' for consistency (fmtDate uses en-GB, fmtShort does not pass locale).
